page_title: NAP 2-1 LEC | Napoli v Lecce 14/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli).
90+3' The Napoli players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
90+2' A player from Lecce commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
90+2' The number of shots on goal at present is 4:2.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' Billy Gilmour (Napoli) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Rosario Abisso blows his whistle for a foul.
85' Here is a change. Oumar Ngom is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Sadik Fofana (Lecce).
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Giovane (Napoli) will replace Alisson Santos.
85' The ball is cleared after Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
81' Lecce enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
79' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Antonino Gallo is replaced by Corrie Ndaba (Lecce).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Santiago Pierotti trots off the pitch and is replaced by Konan Ndri (Lecce).
77' Alisson Santos (Napoli) attempts to put the rebound into the top of the net, but his effort from just outside the penalty area is well anticipated and stopped by Wladimiro Falcone.
76' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) prepares to take a corner kick.
74' Alisson Santos (Napoli) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
72' Antonio Conte has decided to make a change. Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) replaces Leonardo Spinazzola.
72' Matteo Politano has picked up an injury and is replaced by Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli).
71' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
70' Napoli keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition.
67' 2 - 1 Goal! Matteo Politano (Napoli) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 2:1.
67' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) will take a corner kick.
64' A lofted pass into the box is met by Walid Cheddira (Lecce), who rifles a shot just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
62' Matteo Politano (Napoli) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
61' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Walid Cheddira (Lecce) comes onto the pitch so that Nikola Stulic can be given a rest.
57' Rosario Abisso blows his whistle. Sam Beukema (Napoli) commits a foul after dangerous play.
56' Scott McTominay (Napoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
55' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) tries to find Alisson Santos, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
54' Great teamplay by Napoli as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
52' Lameck Banda (Lecce) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
50' Alisson Santos (Napoli) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
50' Oumar Ngom (Lecce) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Rosario Abisso blows his whistle for a foul. Napoli are awarded the free kick.
46' 1 - 1 Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) collects a delightful pass inside the box and nets with a perfect low drive into the middle of the goal. What a clinical finish!
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Omri Gandelman (Lecce) is coming onto the pitch as Lassana Coulibaly cannot continue after picking up an injury.
46' Antonio Conte has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) replacing Frank Anguissa.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Eljif Elmas departs the field of play to be replaced by Scott McTominay (Napoli).
46' The whistle blows and Rosario Abisso starts the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Napoli are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.

45+1' Ooh that was close! Matteo Politano (Napoli) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) will deliver the corner kick.
45' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom right corner, but Alex Meret is equal to it and makes an easy save.
44' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Napoli.
42' The game is interrupted now, Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
39' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) makes a rough challenge and Rosario Abisso blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Napoli hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
33' The Napoli players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
31' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
30' Napoli seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
28' The resulting corner from Antonino Gallo (Lecce) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
26' Neat passing move from Napoli in order to create new attacking opportunities.

24' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Lecce are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
24' Ball possession – 77:23.
22' Sam Beukema (Napoli) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
22' A quickly taken corner by Napoli.
22' Matteo Politano (Napoli) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
19' Jamil Siebert (Lecce) is booked.
19' Lameck Banda (Lecce) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.

17' That was close by Billy Gilmour (Napoli)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
16' The referee awards a corner and Antonino Gallo (Lecce) goes over to take it.
15' Lameck Banda (Lecce) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
14' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

12' Matteo Politano (Napoli) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
11' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
11' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
10' A corner kick by Napoli is thwarted by the well prepared Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce).
10' Matteo Politano (Napoli) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
9' Nice passing game by Lecce. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.

7' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
6' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
5' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Alisson Santos (Napoli) takes it short.
4' Alisson Santos (Napoli) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

3' 0 - 1 Jamil Siebert (Lecce) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet a cross the corner kick and scores with a great header into the top right corner. The goalkeeper had no chance to react. The score is now 0:1.
2' The ball goes out of play. Lecce are awarded a corner kick.
2' Alex Meret leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Antonino Gallo (Lecce).
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lecce will have the kick-off.
Rosario Abisso is introduced as the referee for today's match.
